name: AV-98 Ingram
description: The AV-98 Ingram (AV stands for 'Advanced Vehicle') was developed specially for the police force to combat labor crime. Its slim design is meant to look like a hero of justice and reassure the public. It carries a stun stick, stored under the shield on its left arm, and a 37mm revolver cannon, with spare rounds stored in its right leg. The mechanics of SV2 also built a 90mm riot gun for it. Division 2 of SV2 uses these labors. Ohta's Ingram (Unit 2) has a head that differs from the standard one, and so does Unit 3, the spare. In 'Patlabor 2: The Movie', Unit 3 is an experimental anti-electronic warfare labor with an ECM jamming pod on its head.

name: ASUKA96MPL
description: The police version of the ASUKA95SSL 'Taisho' construction labor, released by Shinohara in October. MPL stands for 'Main Police Labor'. Its armour was reinforced at the cost of agility, and by the time it was delivered it was already no match for illegally modified criminal labors. It was the first labor of SV2: Division 1 used it in the original OVA, and Division 2 in the first episodes of the TV series.

name: AV-X0 Type Zero
description: Essentially the AV-98 Ingram on steroids, this prototype is much stronger than the Ingram and can lift a construction labor with one hand and break it in two. It was designed for hand-to-hand combat and runs the new HOS operating system. In 'Patlabor: The Movie', Kanuka Clancy pilots it when the virus hidden in HOS makes it go berserk. Shinohara also produced a version for the New York Police Department called the AV-02 Clash Buster, which carries a 44mm cannon, but it does not appear in the anime.

name: MPL-97S Python
description: Used by Division 1 in the TV series. This Labor may not be as good as the Ingram, but is still effective against most construction Labors. The term MPL stands for 'Main Police Labor'.

name: AV-0 Peacemaker
description: The AV-0 is Shinohara's final development of the Ingram line and its intended replacement. Three units replaced the Pythons of Division 1 in October 1999. It carries the same police equipment as the Ingram, but its software and engineering are far more advanced: it learns its pilot's movements and copies them, so it can keep operating even if the pilot loses consciousness. It is stronger and faster than the Ingram, but relies more on its technology than on its pilot, which is both a strength and a weakness. It proves no match for the Griffon, and the Division 1 units end that fight badly damaged. A version is also planned for the NYPD's labor unit.

name: AV-2 Valiant
description: The successor to the Ingram, seen in 'Patlabor 2: The Movie'. Six units were delivered when SV2 was reorganized in autumn 2001, three for each division. Its cockpit has a clear canopy and more room than the Ingram's, and pilots board through a rear hatch. It has a retractable speaker on its chest and retractable police lights on its shoulders. The Lehrer is its training version.

name: Type 99 Road Runner
description: The Type 99 wheeled labor of the Kanagawa Prefectural Police's traffic unit, seen in 'Patlabor 2: The Movie'. It moves on eight wheels instead of walking, and in its high-speed mode it looks like a futuristic patrol car. Its two-seat cockpit, for a driver and a commander, rests on extendable legs that let it step over traffic jams, and it has arms for handling objects.

name: MPL97AV-T
description: A training labor built by Shinohara from the Ingram prototype and used at police training schools. It appears in the original OVA.

name: AV-98T Dauphin
description: A training labor built from the Ingram prototype. It is slightly more agile than the Ingram, but its armour and sensors are simplified, and its cockpit is open-top. It is used at the police academy in Okutama and first appears in the TV episode 'Kanuka Has Arrived'.

name: Lehrer
description: The training version of the AV-2 Valiant, used at the Hachioji training school. Its cockpit is open-top and pilots board from the back. It appears only in 'Patlabor 2: The Movie'.

name: SRX-70
description: A prototype offered to Division 1 as the Python's replacement in the TV series. Its heavy weapons were meant to gather combat data for military labors, and Nagumo blocks its adoption. It is later sold for private security as the Saturn.

name: Type-J9 Griffon
description: The "black labor", built in secret by Shaft's Planning Section 7 to outperform every existing labor. Piloted by Bud, it is Section 2's greatest rival in the manga, the TV series and the second OVA series.

name: Type-7 Brocken
affiliation: NATO forces and the West German army
description: A heavily armed and armoured military labor used for border defense. According to Utsumi, its software is behind the Ingram's but its hardware is superior.

name: ARL-99 Hel-Diver
affiliation: Japan Ground Self-Defense Force Mechanized Airborne Division
description: The Ground Self-Defense Force's Type 99 airborne labor. Developed alongside the Ingram and sharing its basic frame, it is more agile and versatile than the earlier military labors it replaced.

name: HL-96 Tyrant 2000
description: A heavy construction labor that looks like a walking bulldozer with arms. Powerful but slow, it was a best seller that established Hishii in the labor industry, and it appears in almost every Patlabor series.

name: HL-98 Hercules 21
description: A heavy construction labor that succeeds the Bulldog. It is more human-shaped and dexterous than the Tyrant, has a sealed cockpit and a periscope snorkel that lets it work underwater.

name: TFV-97 Crabman
description: A four-legged land leveling labor whose legs double as arms. Wheels in its feet let it move fast on roads, and it can keep walking even after losing a leg.
